name: beforeyoudecideit
description: Before You Decide — a static site. No bundler and no runtime dependencies; the two packages below are build-only.

scripts.build: node scripts/render-crystal.mjs && node scripts/generate-decision-map.mjs --fixture price-change && node scripts/build-pages.mjs && node scripts/inline-css.mjs
scripts.check: node scripts/render-crystal.mjs --check && node scripts/build-pages.mjs --check && node scripts/inline-css.mjs --check && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
